newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares add on, seen treading water.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares add on, seen treading water.

text.p: Austria's blue-chip ATX index closed firmer and above key resistence at 1,210 points on Thursday, but traders say it will likely consolidate in the short term amid a lack of trading incentives.
The ATX index rose 5.56 points or 0.46 percent to 1,215.27, with nine shares gaining and 12 falling.
Traders said today's gains were supported by investor demand and, in certain stocks, good turnover.
"Turnover was partly quite superb, but there's still scepticism around. The forecast is rather for a consolidation," said one trader, than a push for the psychologically significant 1,220 points.
The ATX could have "room up to 1,260 points" if 1,220 is broken through "but it's more likely headed for another correction than further climb," said another trader.
The day's top performer was engineering group VA Tech, adding on 3.19 percent to 1,910 ATS while Vienna airport operator Flughafen led decliners, shedding 0.89 percent to 501.50 ATS.

Fireproof materials maker Radex forged ahead to another year high, gaining 10.5 ATS to 490.5. Cartonboard maker Mayr-Melnhof, gained five ATS to 590 after saying it expected to turn in a good set of first half earnings.
The all-share Vienna bourse index advanced 1.36 points, or 0.3 percent, to 456.63.
The May ATX future rose 7.7 points to 1,209.7 on turnover of 1,076 contracts.
